# HELIX templates for the blueprint's proposal tests

From HELIX (github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/helix, MIT):

- the solution-design and architecture templates of v0.18.0, with the
  `output` part of their `meta.yml`;
- the user-flow, wireframe and user-journey-map types of v0.20.0, and its
  design-system (DESIGN.md) template with the Modalities, Size Classes and
  App Frame section, each with its full `meta.yml`.

The tests install them over the starter set's templates in
`packages/create-app/test/fixtures/helix-package/`, as an app's
`.claude/skills/helix/references/`.
